end.summary:
Practised making numbers 11–20 with one bundle of ten and loose sticks.
Saanvi identified one bundle as ten and one loose stick as one more.
For 14, they used one bundle and four loose sticks but counted the parts as 1 + 4.
The connection between the bundle’s value of ten and fourteen was not yet demonstrated in teach-back.
Lesson ended when Saanvi said they were tired.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised representing numbers as one group of ten plus extra ones. They correctly described one bundle and one loose stick as ten and one more, but the counting mix-up for fourteen was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, use 10 grouped objects and 1–9 single objects to build numbers such as 14, saying “ten and four make fourteen.”
